items.title: Bitcoin Miners Are Selling Their Stacks to Fund the AI Boom
items.summary: MARA sold 13,597 BTC after September and Riot sold 20,264 BTC through September to fund debt repayment and AI data center buildouts, as Glassnode flagged the pair as the main sellers among Bitcoin treasury firms.

items.title: Fed's Waller Calls for 50-Basis-Point Rate Hike, Says Tokenized Finance Still Needs Traditional Banks
items.summary: Christopher Waller says stubborn inflation may warrant a bigger December rate hike, while a separate speech outlined why blockchain-based payments still need traditional settlement systems and stronger safeguards to scale.

items.title: Movie2K Defendant Could Hand Over 40,000 Bitcoin to End Trial—and Stay a Billionaire
items.summary: A German judge has offered to drop the charges if the alleged operator of the piracy site gives up most of his remaining Bitcoin.
